text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon claims a magnificent 1st 
place in the Kawasaki Kinen. With 
overwhelming speed, she didn't let anyone 
get near her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the tangible proof of her own 
strength, she gained the confidence that 
she, too, could someday make a splash in 
overseas races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her Trainer invites her to an after-party 
to celebrate the win. However, Smart 
Falcon turns it down, determined to keep 
racking up even more first-place finishes.
